Suryakumar Yadav dropped from Mumbai Indians squad

Suryakumar Yadav has been excluded from the Mumbai Indians squad. Selectors cited a lack of experience with the red ball as the reason for his omission, with reports indicating that all selectors had previously refused to consider him due to this.
